dvids.title: USS McFaul Returns to Norfolk Following Deployment
dvids.desc: NAVAL STATION NORFOLK. Va. (Oct. 23, 2026) – B-roll of the Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS McFaul (DDG 74) pulling into port during the warship’s homecoming at Naval Station Norfolk. McFaul’s return concludes a deployment to the U.S. 5th and 6th Fleet areas of operation. (U.S. Navy

dvids.title: USS McFaul (DDG 74) Returns to Norfolk Following Deployment
dvids.desc: NAVAL STATION NORFOLK, Va. – The Arleigh Burke-class guided-missile destroyer USS McFaul (DDG 74) returned to Naval Station Norfolk, Oct. 23, 2026, concluding an 11-month deployment to the U.S. 5th and 6th Fleet areas of operation.
